question: Evaluate: 6 + 6 of 6 ÷ 6 – (6)/(5)
solution:
Given

**Calculation:**

⇒ 6 + 6 of 6 ÷ 6 – (6)/(5)

⇒ 6 + 36 ÷ 6 – (6)/(5)

⇒ 12 - (6)/(5)

⇒ (60 - 5)/5

⇒ 54/5

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
